hook: Wallace serves as President and CEO of Huston-Tillotson University in Austin, Texas, a historically Black university.
name: Melva Wallace

quote.text: President and CEO at Huston-Tillotson University - Austin, Texas

reading.body:
Melva Wallace leads Huston-Tillotson University, a historically Black university in Austin, Texas, positioning her as an advocate within higher education administration.

Her role gives her influence over institutional decisions about curriculum, research partnerships, and resource allocation at a university in a major tech hub. Austin's growing demand for AI talent and compute infrastructure means that decisions by leaders at regional universities affect the pipeline of trained workers and the institutions available to partner with data centers and AI firms seeking grid capacity and real estate.

This data does not cover Wallace's specific positions on AI policy, her university's actual AI programs or partnerships, or her engagement with the broader ecosystem. It identifies only her title and institutional affiliation.
